result.brief: PointWAM 将世界分解为场景与手部，在共享时空坐标系中联合预测 3D 点轨迹，并用于灵巧操作的动作预测。
result.reason: PointWAM learns a 3D point-trajectory world action model for dexterous manipulation, a world-modeling representation contribution, but its main contribution is robot policy/control, placing it in the secondary application direction.
